import {h, mount, update, flush, unmount, lifecycle} from '/frameworks/adapter.mjs';
const checks={};
const root=document.getElementById('app');
const serverMain=root.firstChild, serverButton=document.getElementById('increment');
const serverItems=Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('li'));
let state={count:variant,items:[1,2,3],message:'server'};
const increment=()=>{state={...state,count:state.count+1};update(state);};
const view=state=>h('main',null,[h('p',{id:'count'},'Count: '+state.count),h('button',{id:'increment',onClick:increment},'Increment'),h('ul',null,state.items.map(value=>h('li',{key:value,'data-key':value},String(value)))),h('p',{id:'message'},state.message)]);
const changes=[];const observer=new MutationObserver(records=>changes.push(...records));observer.observe(root,{childList:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,subtree:true});
mount(view,state,root);
checks.hydratedRoot=serverMain===root.firstChild;
checks.hydratedButton=serverButton===document.getElementById('increment');
checks.hydratedItems=serverItems.every((item,index)=>item===root.querySelectorAll('li')[index]);
checks.mounted=lifecycle.mounted===1;
checks.initialText=document.getElementById('count').textContent==='Count: '+variant;
globalThis.comparison=(async()=>{
  serverButton.dispatchEvent(new Event('click',{bubbles:true}));
  await flush();
  checks.eventUpdate=document.getElementById('count').textContent==='Count: '+(variant+1);
  checks.eventIdentity=serverButton===document.getElementById('increment');
  state={...state,items:[3,1,4]};update(state);await flush();
  checks.keyedOrder=root.querySelector('ul').textContent==='314';
  checks.keyedIdentity=serverItems[2]===root.querySelector('[data-key="3"]') && serverItems[0]===root.querySelector('[data-key="1"]');
  checks.keyedRemoved=serverItems[1].parentNode===null;
  const response=await fetch('/frameworks/data/'+variant);const payload=await response.json();
  state={...state,message:payload.message};update(state);await flush();
  checks.fetchedMessage=document.getElementById('message').textContent==='loaded-'+variant;
  checks.mutationDelivery=changes.length>0 && changes.some(record=>record.type==='childList'||record.type==='characterData');
  checks.ownedInterfaces=root instanceof HTMLElement && serverMain.ownerDocument===document;
  observer.disconnect();unmount(root);await flush();
  checks.unmounted=root.childNodes.length===0 && lifecycle.unmounted===1;
  return checks;
})();
